title: H^n on a set of positive lower density is dominated by the weight when theta >= 1
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a set in R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) a contract rectifiable n-varifold in U with weight mu = V.weight = (H^n restricted to M) with density ofReal(theta), O an open set with mu(O) < infinity, and Gamma a subset of O. Assume theta >= 1 mu-a.e., and every y in Gamma has positive lower density: there are c > 0 and s_0 > 0 with ofReal(c s^n) <= mu(B_s(y)) for all 0 < s < s_0. Then H^n restricted to Gamma is <= mu as measures; in particular H^n(Gamma \ M) = 0, and H^n(B cap Gamma) <= mu(B) for every set B.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (O Γ : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen O → V.weight O < ⊤ → Γ ⊆ O → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ V.mult x) → (∀ y ∈ Γ, ∃ c s₀ : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < s₀ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (c * s ^ n) ≤ V.weight (closedBall y s)) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict Γ ≤ V.weight
